basic_info.description: A rare opportunity to acquire a quintessential trophy property in the heart of Noe Valley, one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. This stately corner building has been owned by the same family for over 50 years and exudes pride of ownership throughout. The property consists of six expansive, full-floor flats, each offering 3 bedrooms and classic period details, including coved ceilings, built-ins, and wood floors. All units are separately metered for PG&E, and the building includes four independent garage parking spaces, as well as shared deck and garden areas. Generating strong income, this is an outstanding investment with long-term upside and appeal. Ideally located at the corner of Vicksburg and Elizabeth, just steps from the vibrant 24th Street corridor, with its beloved cafes, shops, restaurants, and excellent neighborhood amenities.
